node.statement: Moreover 0<=delta+epsilon_{A_R}<=(K+1)*t<=(K+1)*e_3<=e_iso_unit. Since B_U oplus B_V is a finite-dimensional C*-algebra and A_R is the stated finite-dimensional extended epsilon_{A_R}-C*-algebra, lem-maincb-isomorphism-unit-control applied to v gives ||v(I_{B_U oplus B_V})-I_{A_R}||<=C_iso_unit*(delta+epsilon_{A_R})<=C_iso_unit*(K+1)*t<=D_3*t. The designated unit I_{A_R} is the u_{A_R} appearing in node 1, so this is exactly the required unit estimate. Since W and the Stage-3 datum were arbitrary, the two conclusions prove node 1.
